Name: Cosmetology- Beauty Products and Cosmetics
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
The Cosmetology Mod was designed as an ode to my lab days and the many machines and analyzers I had to use. I wanted to have a more industrial/scientific aesthetic and playthrough in mind while keeping things fun. I also wanted to play with the idea of having a manufacturing pipeline: one machine's output is another machine's input. Playing this with additional mods like Automate and Stardio is encouraged, but that is all up to you! 

[center][size=4][b][u]Getting Started[/u][/b][/size][/center]
You will receive the manual via mail in a couple of in-game days. The bulk of the mod starts after you learn the Furnace recipe from Clint, so the sooner you find some copper ore, the better!  Helper Quests and Mail (can be disabled) are designed to give a basic tutorial to the mod and get some ingredients a bit earlier so you can make things sooner!
You can use this mod with an existing save. It may take a couple of days of sleep for it to kick in.


[center][size=4][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size][/center]
A Manual that will help keep you informed and contain all recipes from the start! To open the manual, right-click while your farmer is holding it. To close it, press the ESC key.  For mobile or tablet users, I recommend having a Virtual Keyboard to do this. I hope to figure out how to add an actual exit tab button sometime in the (distant) future.

Machines come in 12 colors in two different styles: Industrial, based on game sprites of machines, or Hi-Tech, a sleeker, ultra-modern look. Use GMCM to change them in-game at any time. Matching Hi-Tech schemes for regular craftables are available. Chests have also been changed. An Alternative Textures mod to mix and match the chests is located in the Optional Files tab.[/spoiler]

[center][b][u][size=4]Notes[/size][/u][/b][/center]

Any translations are welcome! If anybody wants to use my assets for their own Stardew Valley projects, just credit me, and go nuts. Just don't charge people for anything, 'kay? I acknowledge that cosmetics gift tastes may need adjusting if using mods that change the characters (DSV, genderbends, etc.). If anyone would like to make custom gift tastes themselves based on such mods, I would happily include them as an option and credit the heck out of ya! If you have created a character you would like to have special orders and gift tastes for, let me know/what they would like & hate, and I will do my best to include them!

No AI was used in the creation of this mod. It is 100% mine, warts and all. I'll let you decide if that's a good thing or not!
